summary: Fluent relational API: Relation class provides method-chaining (filter/sort/head/join/group_by/agg/select/with_columns/rename/drop/concat/conform/unnest/params) building a backend-agnostic plan tree. 18 terminal methods (to_polars/pandas/dicts/tuples/dataclasses/pydantic/named_tuples/typed_named_tuples/pyarrow/narwhals/ibis/dict_of_series_*/index_of_*/dict) trigger visitor compilation. GroupedRelation restricts API to .agg(). OptimisationRegistry for extensible AST rewriting.
